title: Figure 5.10: Direction randomization (KAM effect) in IEC magnetic field null region
description: Small diagram captioned 'Figure 5.10. Diagram of Direction Randomization (KAM effect) Due to the Magnetic Field Null Region in the IEC', showing field lines converging into a null region with particle trajectories exiting at randomized angles; labels include 'Field Region Entering', 'Null-Field Region' and 'Particle Trajectory with Significant v'. The page also contains concluding remarks on the MCSA fusion concept and references 5.1-5.2.
